scope: Local evidence dossier metadata for medication polymorphism benchmark promotion. This file does not contain coordinate-bearing CIF content.

records.stability_ordering: Racemic modafinil form I is reported as the most stable variety under ordinary temperature-pressure conditions; form III can become the defective steady-state form under dry high-energy milling.
records.stability_claim: Crystal Growth & Design 2007 reports seven forms of racemic modafinil, identifies form I as the most stable variety in T,P space, and describes milling-condition-dependent form I/form III behavior.

form_label_map.mapping_status: blocked: local CIF blocks include enantiomer records and a form-I-like record; form III/form IV local coordinates are not mapped in the current selection.
source_forms: additional racemic modafinil solid forms reported in the literature

records.stability_ordering: The commercial atomoxetine HCl form is reported as the thermodynamically stable polymorph; a metastable crystalline form and amorphous form were also found during development.
records.stability_claim: Journal of Pharmaceutical Sciences 2006 reports stable and metastable atomoxetine HCl crystalline forms, with the stable form selected for commercial product and the metastable form determined by powder diffraction.

form_label_map.mapping_status: blocked: ATOMOXETINE_publ, YIGNEI, and YIGNEI01 need exact mapping to source stable/metastable form labels before promotion.
